title: Constructible separation data in a spectral space
statement:
Let $T,T'\subseteq V$ be disjoint closed subsets of a spectral space $V$ [def-weil-spectral-space].
Select quasi-compact opens $(W,W')$ from
[lemma-nagata-spectral-constructible-separation-exists] and define

$$
T_c=V\setminus W,
\qquad
T'_c=V\setminus W'.
$$

blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: the existence statement
`PrespectralSpace.exists_isCompact_isOpen_disjoint_union_eq_univ`
is used directly, so no selected separation datum and specification lemma
are introduced.

split_report.summary: Definition split without new nodes: retain the two complement formulas and their choice from the existing separation-existence theorem, and add the existing Mathlib leaf def-weil-spectral-space for the ambient notion. Read the blueprint definition and Stacks Tag 0F3W (flat.tex, lemma-blowup-iso-along, first proof paragraph). The project existence theorem is closed in the supplied sorry map and supplies the choice, so no data is selected from an unproved mere existence claim. Six logged Mathlib searches found interpolation but no declaration defining the selected pair. No proof or specification properties are added to this definition. Second reading restored the imported source field, which is maintainer-owned; the checked Stacks reference is flat.tex, Tag 0F3W, label lemma-blowup-iso-along, first proof paragraph (lines 9620–9630). Two independently phrased, logged Mathlib searches confirm that the selected pair has no identified exact declaration.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the statement of def-nagata-spectral-constructible-separation, namely selection of (W,W′) from lemma-nagata-spectral-constructible-separation-exists and the two complement formulas. Its source has no proof. The bypassed status note is preserved as historical import metadata; no unit proof step or route is replaced.
